capabilities: Add icons to files and folders
Insert icons into note content and above titles
Use predefined icon packs or custom SVG icons
Apply custom rules to assign icons automatically
Change the color of individual icons
extras: The README announces the project's deprecation and end of maintenance and refers users to external documentation for details.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visually mark files, folders, or note text with icons.
summary: Icon picker that adds SVG or icon-pack icons to files, folders, notes, tabs, and titles.
